title: Chicken Caprese Skillet
description: Pan-seared chicken breast topped with melted mozzarella, fresh tomatoes and a balsamic reduction.
steps: Sear the chicken in a hot skillet until nearly cooked through.
Top with tomato and mozzarella, cover and cook until the cheese melts.
Reduce the balsamic vinegar in a small pan and drizzle over, finishing with fresh basil.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste chicken caprese skillet

notes: One pan, minimal cleanup — a genuinely quick weeknight dinner with a restaurant-style presentation.
